name: decisions-codex
description: Codex IDE/chat bridge for DecisionsAI project orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex IDE chats and workflow tickets to DecisionsAI project orchestration.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex IDE/chat sessions to DecisionsAI project orchestration. Codex can receive bounded ticket packets or ordinary project prompts, work inside the linked project folder, report prompts, status, changed files, tests, evidence, blockers, steering, waiting, and completion events back to DecisionsAI, and let the Hermes-backed run ledger retain execution memory.
defaultPrompt: Start a DecisionsAI-linked Codex project chat.
Run this DecisionsAI ticket and report evidence.
Continue this workflow step and return status.
